description: PAM registry lifecycle — failed migration rollback: corrupted backup triggers rollback, previous state restored
scenario: Two services enabled (gdm-password, sudo). sudo's backup is corrupted. migrate → enable_service(sudo) fails with BackupChecksumMismatch → restore_snapshot restores PAM files + registry from snapshot.
steps: enable gdm-password + sudo (both get blocks, backups, registry entries)
migrate → snapshot taken, enable(gdm-password) succeeds, enable(sudo) fails at verify_backup (checksum mismatch)
restore_snapshot: PAM files restored from snapshot, registry restored from snapshot
rollback_mechanism: snapshot() saves registry.json + pam.d/<service> for each enabled service. On migrate failure, restore_snapshot() atomically writes each PAM file from the snapshot and saves the restored registry.

verification.e2e: fake-root binary test: migrate FAILED (rolled back), gdm-password block present, registry intact
